items.issue: The official page enforces 12 units of 3000/4000-level COMP courses but says additional prerequisites depend on the announced Advanced Topic and are not specified on this page.
items.action: Enforce the published 12-unit rule and verify the topic-specific prerequisites manually after the Advanced Topic is announced.

items.issue: The 2026 official page does not publish permission to receive credit more than once for different topics.
items.action: Do not double-count repeated COMP4680 enrolments unless the School confirms that repeat credit is permitted.

requisiteAndIncompatibility.officialText: 12 units of 3000 and/or 4000 level COMP courses. Additional Prerequisite courses for the Advanced Topic will be listed on the SoCo website (Special Topics in Computing page) when the course topic is announced. Students who meet the pre-requisites can request a permission code following the instructions for Enrolling in CECC courses. Incompatible with COMP8650.

otherConditions.officialText: Additional Prerequisite courses for the Advanced Topic will be listed on the SoCo website (Special Topics in Computing page) when the course topic is announced.
Students who meet the pre-requisites can request a permission code following the instructions for Enrolling in CECC courses.

Familiarity with linear algebra (including norms, inner products, determinants, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition); basic probability theory; multivariate differential calculus; exposure to mathematical proofs; and experience with Python programming.
